title: Employ staff under the Restaurant Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Restaurant Industry Award 2020.

reach.note: Restaurants, cafes, reception centres, night clubs and roadhouses; restaurants in premises of employers under the Hospitality, Clubs or Fast Food awards are excluded (cl 4.2). National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Restaurant Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 In this award restaurant industry means restaurants, reception centres, night clubs, cafés or roadhouses and includes catering by a restaurant business and a tea room operated in, or in connection with, a restaurant business but does not include a restaurant operated in, or in connection with, premises owned or operated by an employer covered by any of the following awards: (a) Hospitality Industry (General) Award 2020 ; or [4.2(b) varied by PR743467 ppc 11Jul22] (b) Registered and Licensed Clubs Award 2020 ; or (c) Fast Food Industry Award 2010 .

assessment.summary: The Restaurant Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
